notes: Atrium v0.7.0 — The Cockpit Foundation: a new dashboard with every project's live status at a glance, read-only git diff + commit-graph views, automatic detection of package.json/Makefile/justfile scripts, a configurable editor (VS Code / Cursor / Zed / Windsurf / custom), per-project scratchpad notes and a TODOs dock, and atrium.toml project import/export. Plus polish: non-selectable chrome, right-click-to-paste in the terminal, and worktrees no longer re-prompt for tools you've already approved.
